subject: IAM artifacts & engineer interview: SAML assertions, SCIM deltas, role mapping
messages:
From: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightlinehealth.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightlinehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SAML/SCIM artifacts + role mapping (SIG/SOC2)

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for taking our SIG/SOC2 intake. We're collecting IAM proof artifacts for our security review and have a few asks that need short turnaround (target: 2027-07-09). Specifically we need:

- Representative SAML assertion samples (including NameID/NameQualifier variants) for web SSO flows
- SCIM delta export covering changes for the last 30 days (format or CSV sample is OK)
- Role-to-permission mapping for your product roles (service accounts + human roles) and the stated retention windows for audit logs
- Confirmation of least-privilege reasoning for privileged roles and a short owner list for each role
- Inventory of service accounts and classification (automation vs. human-managed)

We'd also like to schedule a 30-minute technical interview with whoever owns SCIM syncs and the provisioning playbook to clarify a few items. Slots available for us: Tue 29 Jun 10-12 PT or Wed 30 Jun 14-16 PT.

Can you confirm owners and whether you can deliver samples by 7/9?

Appreciate it — Tom

--
Tom Ellis
Director of Security Operations
Brightline Health

From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SAML/SCIM artifacts + role mapping (SIG/SOC2)

Hi Tom — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. I will own coordination and Ben will lead the SCIM extraction and SAML samples. Laura will help with the privilege matrix and owner roster.

Plan (high level):
- Deliver SAML assertion examples and a small doc describing NameID formats by 2027-07-02
- Provide a redacted SCIM delta CSV (30-day window) by 2027-07-06
- Share a role -> permission matrix and service account inventory by 2027-07-09
- Technical interview: Ben can take the 30-min slot on Tue 29 Jun 10:30-11:00 PT — does that work for your team?

Attachments: redwood_iam_checklist_v1.pdf (checklist we typically send), privilege-matrix-v1.xlsx (working draft). We'll mark anything sensitive and redact IDs.

If that timeline is tight, let me know and we can prioritize assertions + SCIM first.

Thanks,
Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightlinehealth.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 11:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SAML/SCIM artifacts + role mapping (SIG/SOC2)

Tom / Grace — quick technical note from the SCIM/SAML side:

SCIM deltas
- We can export a CSV with fields: timestamp, action (create/update/delete), externalId, userName, groups, adminStatus, sourceSystem.
- We'll redact personal emails and replace with hashed placeholders (sha256 prefix). Example file: scim_delta_sample.csv attached.

SAML assertions
- Our IdP is Okta. We'll provide two assertion variants: one for standard SP-initiated web SSO (transient NameID) and one for persistent NameID for API clients. The assertions will include sample AttributeStatement maps (roles, email, user.id). See saml_assertion_examples.txt.

Role mapping and service accounts
- Attached privilege-matrix-v1.xlsx has preliminary mapping. We tag service accounts with owner tags and classification column. Service accounts used for batch inference jobs are in the "automation" bucket; they are rotated via our central KMS with 90-day keys.

Retention windows
- Audit logs (authn/assertion logs) retained 365 days; SCIM delta exports kept 90 days in cold storage, with longer retention available on request.

I'll bring the SCIM export process in the interview. Confirming Ben can meet Tue 29 Jun 10:30 PT.

-ben

--
Ben Carter
Staff Platform Engineer, Identity
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightlinehealth.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightlinehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 12:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SAML/SCIM artifacts + role mapping (SIG/SOC2)

Thanks Ben — this looks good. A couple of quick clarifications before the interview:

1) Role granularity: for our SIG, we need to show permission-level detail for any role that grants elevated access (e.g., user management, billing, deployment controls). Can you expand the matrix to show specific API scopes / console capabilities where possible?

2) Privileged accounts: do the service accounts used on HPC/gpu clusters fall under the same rotation and owner model? If yes, please call out rotation cadence and owners.

3) Retention: 365d for authn logs is fine. For SCIM delta exports we need to understand if there is an immutable store / tamper-evidence (e.g., write-once object or signed export). If not, note that will be a shortcoming we record in the SIG.

We'll take Tue 29 Jun 10:30 PT for the interview. Also, our SIG deadline is 2027-07-12 so the July 9 delivery is helpful; please shoehorn the SAML and SCIM samples earlier if possible.

Best,
Elena

--
Elena Ruiz
Senior Security Engineer
Brightline Health

From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@brightlinehealth.com>, Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 14:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SAML/SCIM artifacts + role mapping (SIG/SOC2)

Elena — thanks for the clarifying questions. Action summary and owners below: 

- SAML assertion examples (NameID variants + AttributeStatement): Ben — deliver 2027-07-01 (saml_assertion_examples.txt)
- SCIM delta sample (30-day, redacted): Ben — deliver 2027-06-30 (scim_delta_sample.csv)
- Privilege matrix with API/console-level notes: Laura — deliver 2027-07-06 (privilege-matrix-v1.xlsx initial; expanded note coming)
- Service account classification (HPC/gpu included) and rotation cadence: Ben & Laura — call out in matrix and in interview
- Tamper-evidence note: we'll include how exports are signed and stored; if we don't have immutable WORM storage for the SCIM exports we'll provide a signed digest chain (SHA256) to demonstrate integrity.

Interview confirmed: Tue 29 Jun 10:30-11:00 PT — invite sent to your address. We'll bring an exec-level one-page summary with the artifacts. If anything changes, ping me.

Regards,
Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
